0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: Now that Estinien has joined us, let us again discuss how we should proceed in the face of the Solstice.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: According to Halmarut, it is the fate that awaits should the reflections be allowed to merge of their own accord─an act of healing dictated by the laws of nature.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000030_ALPHINAUD
2.description: Should that come to pass, all creation will be merged into a single whole, and the star restored to a state long before the birth of mankind.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000040_ALPHINAUD
3.description: 'Tis a calamitous event that no one could survive. Not even a vestige of civilization would remain.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000050_ALISAIE
4.description: To prevent this, the Winterers intend to initiate Rejoinings...

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000060_ALPHINAUD
5.description: Thereby preempting the Solstice and sparing one world, at least, from annihilation.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000062_ALISAIE
6.description: Considering the alternative, there is an argument to be made for the Winterers' approach.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000064_ALISAIE
7.description: But my entire being reels at the thought of it...

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000091_KRILE
9.description: I have been considering what I should do─what I <hex:021A020203>want<hex:021A020103> to do. In the course of which I thought back to our experiences in Tural.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000093_KRILE
10.description: It occurred to me that, right now, perhaps we do not feel so differently to how the Alexandrians once did.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000095_KRILE
11.description: For generations, they had no conception of an end. Of death.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000097_KRILE
12.description: When that blissful ignorance was shattered, they struggled to confront their mortality and drowned in despair.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000099_THANCRED
13.description: You believe our present situation is similar?

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000100_KRILE
14.description: Though it took time, the people of Alexandria learned to overcome their fear.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000102_KRILE
15.description: Through their memories and their queen, they learned that, though death comes for us all, in many ways we live on.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000104_KRILE
16.description: With this knowledge came acceptance, and they were able to embrace a new way of life.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000106_KRILE
17.description: Before aught else, might we not seek to learn as well?

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000112_URIANGER
18.description: We, too, have experiences from which we may take similar lessons.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000114_URIANGER
19.description: For the Promises, the rite of succession was as much an educational journey as it was physical.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000116_URIANGER
20.description: With inquisitive minds did they acquire knowledge that broadened their perspectives. Thus were they shaped into the worthy Vows they did become.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000122_THANCRED
21.description: Having watched over them from start to finish, we know well the importance of getting one's bearings before choosing a direction.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000124_THANCRED
22.description: And as it stands, we know precious little about the Solstice and the Winterers both.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000126_ALPHINAUD
23.description: Indeed, you have the right of it. We ought to learn all we can, the better to decide our own course.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000160_ESTINIEN
24.description: But where to begin? Do we even know where the Winterers are?

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000162_CALYX
25.description: (-Calyx-)Halmarut and I will soon cross the rift to observe the enactment of another Winterer's plan.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000166_ALISAIE
27.description: He told you just like that!? What's he playing at?

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000170_THANCRED
28.description: While I wouldn't be surprised if it was a trap, if the Fourth was specifically chosen from among all worlds, it may nevertheless be worth paying it a visit.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000171_URIANGER
29.description: How to reach it is the question. For aside from the gate unto the Ninth, we have no ready means to traverse worlds.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000172_URIANGER
30.description: 'Twas only by virtue of the Crystal Exarch's magicks that we did arrive in the First.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000174_URIANGER
31.description: While the portal unto the Thirteenth was the fruit of long years of research. The same method is not like to avail us with a reflection unknown.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000175_YSHTOLA
32.description: It is as you say, I'm afraid.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000176_YSHTOLA
33.description: Your recent crossing to the void... Do you have any idea how it happened?

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
35.description: I was worrying about Zero, and the next thing I knew...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000182_GRAHATIA
38.description: It is imbued with an incantation of Azem's invention─a magick to summon forth allies.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000184_GRAHATIA
39.description: And though the origins of Ethos remain unclear, we know for a fact that it has the power to open paths to other places.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000186_GRAHATIA
40.description: In the instant before you vanished, both crystal and key shone brightly, as if resonating with each other.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000188_GRAHATIA
41.description: This interaction strongly suggests that, when invoked together, the relics allow the bearer to travel to the person in their mind's eye.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000192_KRILE
42.description: So <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> managed what Preservation sought to achieve with the actuator purely by chance? That's amazing!

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000202_MYSTERIOUSVOICE
44.description: Hold fast to what you must, and face your fate without fear.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000204_EMETSELCH
45.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Though the world be sundered and our souls set adrift, where you walk, my dearest friend, fate shall surely follow.<hex:0248020103>

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000260_GRAHATIA
46.description: What say you, my friend? Shall we give it a try?

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000262_GRAHATIA
47.description: You needn't try to picture the Fourth─only Halmarut and Calyx.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_010000_ALL
48.description: （大勢の声出力用ラベル・翻訳不要）

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000280_ALPHINAUD
50.description: [SURPRISED YELP, HITTING THE GROUND FROM FALL]

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000310_ALPHINAUD
54.description: Were we...were we caught up in the incantation?

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000330_ESTINIEN
55.description: No sooner did light encase you than I felt some force pulling me.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000332_ESTINIEN
56.description: The next thing I knew, I was here, with you and Alphinaud.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000340_ALPHINAUD
57.description: I see no others. Is it only the three of us?

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000360_ALPHINAUD
58.description: How curious... We were all beside you. Why was no one else transported?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
60.description: I had a vision of snow-swept fields...

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
61.description: I had a vision of a woman who looked like Ysayle...

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
62.description: Perhaps I was just in that sort of mood...?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000370_ALPHINAUD
63.description: I see... Yet that doesn't explain why only Estinien and I are here.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000372_ESTINIEN
64.description: Perhaps thoughts of a frozen world called to mind our journey through Coerthas.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000380_ALPHINAUD
65.description: A woman who looked like Ysayle...

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000382_ESTINIEN
66.description: Whoever that may have been, it would explain why Alphinaud and I were dragged along.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000392_ESTINIEN
68.description: Something made our friend think of us, I suspect. Perhaps thoughts of a frozen world called to mind our journey through Coerthas.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000400_ESTINIEN
69.description: So, what now? We appear to be marooned here.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000410_ALPHINAUD
70.description: Strange. Normally, wind-aspected crystals would be required to levitate such an isle.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000412_ALPHINAUD
71.description: Yet they are bleached white. Overexposed to ice, 'twould seem.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000415_ALPHINAUD
72.description: Calyx said the Fourth is a world locked in ice.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000417_ALPHINAUD
73.description: From what I can see, I daresay we have arrived.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000460_ALPHINAUD
76.description: I've never seen their like. There's no telling what they can do, so have care.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000490_ALPHINAUD
80.description: Was that the last of them?

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000530_ESTINIEN
84.description: This one's their leader, I take it.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000570_VISNA
88.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)Confirmed─three survivors on the isle, Captain! A large thrall is attacking them!

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000580_VISNA
89.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)Per article six of the Pact of Four, we must render aid in open skies! Engaging the thrall!

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000590_VISNA
90.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)We're here to help! Keep your wits about you!

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000600_ALPHINAUD
91.description: Whoever they are, they couldn't have come at a better time. Let's finish this!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000660_ALPHINAUD
99.description: We're grateful for your assistance! Is there any way we might repay this debt?

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000662_VISNA
100.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)Don't be ridiculous─it's only natural to help each other in open skies!

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000663_VISNA
101.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)Though...I do like the sound of “repay”!

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000680_VISNA
104.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)Your brand! Show your brand first!

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000690_ALPHINAUD
105.description: My apologies, but what do you mean by “brand”?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000700_VISNA
106.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)What!? Next you'll be telling me you don't know what a reading rod is!

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000701_ALPHINAUD
107.description: Forgive us if we have caused offense. We are travelers from far away, and truly do not understand your meaning.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000702_VISNA
108.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)Quit the act! Show me your brands─<hex:021A020203>now<hex:021A020103>!

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000704_ALPHINAUD
110.description: I had hoped to refrain from disclosing our origins until we had a better grasp of the situation, but it seems we have no choice.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000715_KETILL
111.description: (-Rugged Skyfarer-)What's going on? There a problem?

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000720_VISNA
112.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)We've dealt with the thralls, but these people─they claim they don't know what a brand is, and it doesn't sound like they're lying...

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000740_VISNA
114.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)I'm going to examine you. Stay still!

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000750_VISNA
115.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)That's odd... Why isn't it responding?

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000752_SALVAGECREWA
116.description: Looks like someone's been neglecting maintenance.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000754_VISNA
117.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)That's rich, coming from the neglecter-in-chief! I always check and double-check all my runeworks before departure!

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000782_VISNA
121.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)But that would mean...these people really <hex:021A020203>don't<hex:021A020103> have brands?

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000784_VISNA
122.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)Well, there's only one way to know for sure. We'll have to get up close.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000786_SALVAGECREWA
123.description: Are you mad!? It's all over if you're wrong about this! Who'd want to take that risk!?

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000788_VISNA
124.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)If they're genuinely stranded and we leave them here to die, we'll be punished for breaching the pact.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000789_VISNA
125.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)None of us want that. But if you aren't game to go over there...

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000791_VISNA
126.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)Then I'll do the honors, and take an extra cut for my troubles! Thirty percent on top, say?

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000793_VISNA
128.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)I trust you heard that, Captain! No feigning ignorance later!

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000796_SALVAGECREWB
131.description: She's really doing it... Does she have a death wish or something?

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000810_VISNA
134.description: (-Young Skyfarer-)How is this possible!? Who are you people? Why are you here!?

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
139.description: Best if you handled this, Alphinaud!

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000850_ALPHINAUD
143.description: Let's begin with introductions, shall we? I am Alphinaud Leveilleur, and these are my comrades...

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000864_VISNA
146.description: Huh? Don't know what a runesmith is?

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000866_VISNA
147.description: Put simply, I craft tools imbued with magic. This requires both knowledge of sorcery as well as the skill to fashion the instruments.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000870_ALPHINAUD
148.description: So you are versed in arcane arts. Little wonder you displayed such mastery over a familiar.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000880_ALPHINAUD
149.description: There are of course many schools of magic. In the course of your studies, did you ever learn about the existence of other worlds?

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000910_VISNA
152.description: J-Just to be sure... When you say “other worlds,” you mean it literally, not figuratively, right?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000920_ALPHINAUD
153.description: I do. Difficult though it may be to believe, they indeed exist─and we hail from one.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000922_ALPHINAUD
154.description: We were deposited here by an unconventional teleportation magick. Hence, what is natural to you may be wholly foreign to us.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000924_ALPHINAUD
155.description: We cannot thank you enough for coming to our aid.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000932_ALPHINAUD
157.description: Far be it from us to ask more of you, but would you tell us about yourselves?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000934_ALPHINAUD
158.description: We would also appreciate being directed to a place where we might lodge. I expect Estinien and I will not be able to return home for some while.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000944_VISNA
161.description: “Prosperous are they who accept burdens others avoid.”

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000946_VISNA
162.description: A personal mantra─and the key to making my fortune!

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000948_VISNA
163.description: Besides, you don't bear a brand or look like unsavory sorts. To begin with, I'll take you to meet my master.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000950_VISNA
165.description: That's right! He's an incredible man who knows things that aren't even written in the <hex:021A020203>Havamal<hex:021A020103>, and teaches me this and that whenever he has time.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000952_VISNA
166.description: He's even familiar with all manner of forgotten magicks, so if anyone has knowledge about other worlds, it'd be him!

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000954_ALPHINAUD
167.description: Thank you, Visna. Without you, we would have no means of descending to the surface.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000958_VISNA
169.description: You really aren't from around here, are you?

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000960_VISNA
170.description: We won't be descending. We can't.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000962_VISNA
171.description: The surface─all of it─has been frozen for five hundred years. We live up here now, in the skies.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000966_VISNA
173.description: Airships. Enormous ones. They're called the Fimm Himnar─the five firmaments left to mankind.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000968_VISNA
174.description: My master and I reside on one of them. The realmship of water, <hex:021A020203>Naglfar<hex:021A020103>.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000970_VISNA
175.description: I'm happy to tell you all about myself and the crew, but I'm not sure where to start...

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000972_ALPHINAUD
176.description: In that case, permit me to take the initiative.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000974_ALPHINAUD
177.description: Earlier, you stated that all of the surface is frozen. To confirm, you meant that the entire <hex:021A020203>world<hex:021A020103> is locked in ice?

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000980_VISNA
178.description: That's right. One day, the world began to grow cold. Cold and still.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_000990_VISNA
179.description: Do you see the expanse of clouds below? That's the Frostglaer, a dangerous stratum that's heavily infused with ice energies.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001000_VISNA
180.description: Long ago, it came to cover the whole world. Everything beneath was frozen solid.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001002_ALPHINAUD
181.description: And so, in order to seek refuge in the skies, mankind constructed colossal flying vessels─the realmships.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001004_VISNA
182.description: You're a fast learner! Now, it's still cold as sin up high, but thanks to the vessels' wards, we can live in relative comfort.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001010_ESTINIEN
184.description: These “brands” that had you in a lather earlier... What is their significance?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001011_VISNA
185.description: So, from the moment we're born, we're magically bound to our realmship.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001012_VISNA
186.description: Take <hex:021A020203>Glaðr<hex:021A020103>'s crew, for example. Everyone calls <hex:021A020203>Naglfar<hex:021A020103> home.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001013_VISNA
187.description: Point a reading rod at any one of us, and the proof of our bond becomes visible─the water brand.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001015_ESTINIEN
188.description: So they signify affiliation. Given your reaction, I thought the situation was rather more dire.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001020_VISNA
189.description: Oh, you'd better believe it was!

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001030_VISNA
190.description: We don't normally think about our brands. But if you get too close to someone who bears a different one─that is, those from another realmship...

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001040_VISNA
191.description: Your heart seizes up! And nine times out of ten, you're dead.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001042_ALPHINAUD
192.description: Everyone is born with this terrifying enchantment!?

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001060_VISNA
194.description: Every vessel has strict protocols in place for the management of resources. Outsiders aren't allowed to come and go as they please, otherwise we wouldn't be able to sustain our way of life.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001070_VISNA
195.description: This system of binding makes it easier to regulate populations and their movement. It was introduced soon after we began living in the skies, and it continues to this day.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001072_ALPHINAUD
196.description: Thank you for enlightening us. Is there aught else you believe we should be aware of?

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001090_VISNA
199.description: The creatures that attacked you─they're thralls of the jötnar.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001100_VISNA
200.description: They harry <hex:021A020203>Naglfar<hex:021A020103> from time to time. And when they do, safety should be your first priority.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001101_ALPHINAUD
201.description: I see. But...what are the jötnar?

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001102_VISNA
202.description: You'll see one for yourself soon enough.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001110_VISNA
203.description: Giants eclipsing the clouds, driven by an insatiable hunger. The thralls hunt men so their masters may feast.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001112_VISNA
204.description: The jötnar themselves chase after the realmships like a shadow, so we have to constantly be on the move.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001114_ALPHINAUD
205.description: We've encountered a number of giant species in our travels, but none quite like what you describe.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001116_ALPHINAUD
206.description: I grow more curious... Why did this world come to be as it is?

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001150_VISNA
208.description: Oh, uh...what I meant to say is...

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001152_VISNA
209.description: When we get to <hex:021A020203>Naglfar<hex:021A020103>, you should probably avoid asking people about the past.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001160_VISNA
210.description: You can ask me whatever you like, but others might find your curiosity a little...uh, odd.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001170_VISNA
211.description: Some things, we just don't talk about.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001172_ALPHINAUD
212.description: We shall bear that in mind.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001180_VISNA
213.description: With that settled, let's make for <hex:021A020203>Naglfar<hex:021A020103> via <hex:021A020203>Glaðr<hex:021A020103>!

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001190_VISNA
214.description: ...After I get permission from Ketill, that is. He's the captain and all.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001200_VISNA
215.description: I'm pretty sure he'll say yes, though. I'll tell him I want to take you to my master...

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001220_ALPHINAUD
216.description: We should personally make an appeal as well.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001245_KETILL
217.description: Looks like you've finished setting the crystals. Good work.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001255_KETILL
218.description: All's set on our end too, so we're gonna cast off now.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001260_ALPHINAUD
219.description: Already? Were you not extracting resources from the isle?

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001262_VISNA
220.description: Oh, but we are... In due course!

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001270_VISNA
221.description: It's a needlessly difficult process when the isle's still frozen, so we normally haul it back to the mother ship while thawing it out.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001281_KETILL
222.description: Strike zones set? Then fire the anchors!

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001305_KETILL
226.description: Raise output to the wind engine! Set course for <hex:021A020203>Naglfar<hex:021A020103>, cruising speed!

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001310_ALPHINAUD
227.description: It calls to mind the battle against Bismarck, does it not?

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001330_VISNA
229.description: These isles are a precious resource. There's always the danger of being attacked by thralls, but the risk is worth the reward.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001345_KETILL
230.description: Right, those not on watch, go get some rest!

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001347_VISNA
231.description: All that's left is to wait until we arrive. Relax, and enjoy the ride.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001348_ALPHINAUD
232.description: In the course of this journey, I wonder what we shall see, hear, feel, and think...

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001700_GRAHATIA
233.description: That is quite a tale... As you disappeared in the same manner as before, we suspected the incantation was successful.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001710_ALISAIE
234.description: We didn't expect Alphinaud and Estinien to be taken with you, however.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001720_ALISAIE
235.description: So... This means I can go too, yes?

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001740_KRILE
237.description: We haven't even determined how Alphinaud and Estinien can return. This is not a power to be invoked lightly.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001750_YSHTOLA
238.description: Krile has the right of it. A single misstep, and we may all end up stranded in the Fourth.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001760_GRAHATIA
239.description: And given the entirely different circumstances, spirit vessels would avail us naught.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001770_GRAHATIA
240.description: So let us be patient, Alisaie, and think of other ways to help.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001780_ALISAIE
241.description: Alright, alright. I'll do what I can here.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001790_ALISAIE
242.description: Alphinaud and Estinien can look after themselves, I know, but keep an eye on them, will you?

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001800_KRILE
243.description: If you wish to keep busy, perhaps you might join me?

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001810_KRILE
244.description: I intend to visit the Ninth to see if there have been any developments following recent events. While there, I also hope to treat those in Treno and elsewhere who suffer from levin sickness.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001820_ALISAIE
245.description: I'd be glad to come along. I'll teach you everything you need to know about porxies.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001830_YSHTOLA
246.description: I shall return to the moon. As the one who opened the voidgate, I should rightly keep a weather eye on it.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001840_THANCRED
247.description: Then I will take myself around to assess voidsent activity and see if aught unusual is afoot.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001850_HOARYBOULDER
248.description: Should you require extra feet on the ground, then ours are at your disposal.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001860_THANCRED
249.description: They'd be most welcome. We'll discuss the details anon.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001870_URIANGER
250.description: 'Twould behoove us to delve into the nature of the star. In unraveling new mysteries might we find the knowledge to forestall the Solstice.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
253.description: I leave it in your capable hands!

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001890_GRAHATIA
255.description: We shall endeavor not to disappoint.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001920_TATARU
258.description: I hope it gets to the mother ship swiftly!

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001575_CALYX
261.description: You are doing this on purpose...

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001580_HALMARUT
262.description: It appears the Warrior of Light has arrived with two of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> comrades.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001585_HALMARUT
263.description: What possessed you to go so far as to invite <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> to the Fourth?

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001590_CALYX
264.description: There is something I would ascertain.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001605_CALYX
266.description: Have I violated the Winterers' covenant?

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001610_HALMARUT
267.description: No, you have not... This was doubtless but a part of fate's grand design.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001612_HALMARUT
268.description: Besides, while the warrior and <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> comrades do not act to forestall the Solstice, you would not knowingly aid them─unless you had a compelling reason.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001614_HALMARUT
269.description: Nevertheless, had you shared your intentions beforehand, I might have offered my cooperation. It would have been more efficient─and spared me the shock.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001622_CALYX
271.description: I wonder if you would say the same were it not the Fourth. For you are bound to this world, are you not, Halmarut?

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001624_CALYX
272.description: Or would you prefer being called by your true name here?

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001630_HALMARUT
273.description: Though my motives may differ from that of Lahabrea and the other unsundered, my objective remains the same─the Rejoining. Halmarut will suffice.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07505_001636_HALMARUT
276.description: It almost brings one to tears...
